notes: Design is not named; cross-sectional is inferred from a single-period telephone survey. Estimates failing NCHS reliability criteria are flagged (**), not suppressed, so no suppression procedure is recorded. Monovalent-booster contrasts tested within age bands (18–49, ≥50) could be read as stratified; the standardization cue is a false hit (cited age-adjusted mortality).
view_issues: The reliability footnote says 'sample size of >30' yet lists 'n<30' as a criterion. Text says Asian adults' primary series completion was higher 'than among those of all other races,' but tests are only against White adults. 'who were reluctance' is a typo.
